scope_rule: Pinned repository trees and preserved archives; latest Mind Change Research delta included. Not every historical commit.
counting_rule: Confirmed defects, qualified unperformed proposals, legitimate procedures, lexical candidates and duplicated occurrences are separate. Inventory size is not a failure count.
review_rule: Per-file ledgers distinguish full prose review, canonical/generated-family review, structured-field review and lexical indexing. File acquisition is not a certificate of semantic completeness.
evidence_rule: Exact source paths, ranges, quotations and constructed counterexamples support the stated judgments. A hypothetical mutation is not represented as original source text.
